extraction.name: Common Corpus
extraction.description: The largest open dataset for language model pre-training, containing about two trillion tokens of uncopyrighted or permissively licensed data.
extraction.creator: PleIAs
extraction.rai:dataCollection: Aggregation of various open datasets into six collections: Open Govemment, Open Culture, Open Science, Open Web, Open Code, and Open Semantic.
extraction.rai:dataCollectionRawData: Data from various open sources including government documents, cultural heritage datasets, scientific papers, code repositories, web sources, and semantic data.
extraction.rai:dataPreprocessingProtocol: Filtering out non-permissible licenses, removing low-quality data, replacing PII with fictitious values, and filtering or rewriting toxic content.
extraction.rai:dataReleaseMaintenancePlan: Continuous updates with HuggingFace archiving past versions.
extraction.rai:dataSocialImpact: Supports the pre-training of fully open and auditable LLMs without violating copyright law.
extraction.rai:dataBiases: Historical texts may contain outdated cultural norms and biases regarding ethnic groups, women, and violence.
extraction.rai:dataLimitations: Does not cover all available open data, shallow coverage for low-resource languages, and not suitable for task-specific fine-tuning.

name.evidence: In this paper, we introduce Common Corpus1, the largest open dataset for language model pre-training.

description.evidence: In this paper, we introduce Common Corpus1, the largest open dataset for language model pre-training. The data assembled in Common Corpus are either uncopyrighted or under permissible licenses and amount to about two trillion tokens.

license.evidence: The data assembled in Common Corpus are either uncopyrighted or under permissible licenses and amount to about two trillion tokens.

inLanguage.evidence: The dataset contains a wide variety of languages, ranging from the main European languages to low-resource ones rarely present in pre-training datasets

isLiveDataset.evidence: Common Corpus will remain an evolving resource reflecting the need for a continuous open infrastructure rather than a fixed dataset, with HuggingFace ensuring a proper archiving of past versions for reproducibility.

rai:dataCollection.evidence: Common Corpus is available on HuggingFace as an aggregation of 10,000 parquet files and is composed of six collections: Open Govemment, Open Culture, Open Science, Open Web, Open Code, and Open Semantic.

rai:dataCollectionType.evidence: All other parts of Open Culture have been collected on a resource-by-resource basis using APIs and other standard retrieval methods whenever available.

rai:dataCollectionRawData.evidence: Common Corpus is available on HuggingFace as an aggregation of 10,000 parquet files and is composed of six collections: Open Govemment, Open Culture, Open Science, Open Web, Open Code, and Open Semantic.

rai:dataCollectionTimeframe.evidence: In this paper, we present Common Corpus , which has been an ongoing effort since 2024

rai:dataPreprocessingProtocol.evidence: To discard the low-quality data, we ran a series of manual filters described by Lozhkov et al. (2024). In addition to those, we removed files consisting of 75% or more of digits... To identify and replace PII, we use Microsoft’s Presidio... we replace PII with fictuous but realistic values.

rai:dataReleaseMaintenancePlan.evidence: Common Corpus will remain an evolving resource reflecting the need for a continuous open infrastructure rather than a fixed dataset, with HuggingFace ensuring a proper archiving of past versions for reproducibility.

rai:dataSocialImpact.evidence: Common Corpus aims to support the pre-training of fully open and auditable LLMs by making it legal to release the source even without the provision of fair use.

rai:dataBiases.evidence: Many texts there are historical periodicals and monographs from at least 80 years ago. Cultural norms surrounding the discussion of certain ethnic groups, women, and themes such as violence have changed dramatically.

rai:dataLimitations.evidence: Common Corpus is far from collecting the whole range of available open data... even though the language diversity of the data is large, the coverage for low-resource languages is still shallow... Common Corpus naturally does not contain data for instruction-tuning and any forms of specialized tasks.

rai:dataUseCases.evidence: In this paper, we introduce Common Corpus1, the largest open dataset for language model pre-training.
